q: How does the design + build process work?
a: Design and construction are coordinated by one team. We begin with your goals and existing conditions, develop the plans and selections with you, then plan and manage construction through the final walkthrough.

q: How long does a typical design + build project take?
a: Timing depends on scope, design decisions, permitting, site conditions, and material availability. We discuss your goals at the first consultation and develop a project-specific schedule as the design and scope become clear.

q: What types of projects does Timber and Love specialize in?
a: Our residential work includes custom homes, whole-home renovations, kitchens and living spaces, additions, new construction, and thoughtful updates to historic homes. Share your project details so we can confirm the right fit.

q: How do you ensure quality in your projects?
a: We coordinate plans, selections, trades, and construction reviews, then walk the finished home with you and address the final detail list. Our portfolio offers a closer look at the materials and finished work.

q: What makes Timber and Love different from other design + build firms?
a: Luke Caldwell’s design point of view and a connected design-and-construction team guide the work. You collaborate on a plan for your home, with the same team carrying the design intent into the build.
